mariyādavelā: [Mariyādā+velā]  CL=9 The shore which is the boundary.
mariyādavelātikkanta: [Mariyādavelā+atikkanta]  CL=9 Gone beyond the shore of boundary.
mariyādavibhāga: [Mariyādā+vibhāga] (pu) CL=7 Classified by the boundary. The way of classification.
mariyādavibhāgadassana: [Mariyādavibhāga+dassana] (na) CL=7 Showing the way of criticism that is criticized by boundary or limit.
mariyādavācaka: [Mariyādā+vācaka] (ti) CL=7 Taught (or) explained the boundary or limit (or) staying within limits.
mariyādavītikkama: [Mariyādā+vītikkama] (pu) CL=7 Breaking the boundary. Breaking the rules.
mariyādaṭṭhāna: [Mariyādā+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 The demarcated place (or) a place of boundary (or) limit.
mariyādā: [Pari+ā+dā+a.paricchitva] (thī,pu) CL=7 [Ādīyateti mariyādā,passamo.māna,ṭī226.(mayyīdā-saṃ)] (1) The limit (or) boundary. Keeping the rules. (A) Small embankment. Embankment. (2) The behavior (or) habit.
mariyādābhāva: [Mariyādā+abhāva] (pu) CL=7 Lack of boundaries (or) limit (or) rules.
mariyādācāritta: [Mariyādā+cāritta] (na) CL=7 The practice that is keeping the rules.
mariyādākopana: [Mariyādā+akopana] (na) CL=7 Do not break the rules.
mariyādātikkanta: [Mariyādā+atikkanta] (ti) CL=7 Gone beyond the boundaries (or) rules.
maru: [Mara+u] (pu) CL=7 [Mara pāṇacāge, u, maru, devepi. Dhāna,ṭī.663. Nīti,dhā.158.] (1) Sand. Sandbank without water. (2) Mountain. See - Marupapāta. (3) Deva.
marubhūmimagga: [Marubhūmi+magga] (pu) CL=7 Sand Road. The road where is full of sand (or) desert road.
marugaṇaparivuta: [Marugaṇa+parivuta] (ti) CL=7 One who is surrounded by many Devas.
marugaṇaparivārita: [Marugaṇa+parivārita] (ti) CL=7 One who is surrounded by many Devas.
marumba: Smaller stone (or) pebble. Marumba(pu) Smaller stone (or) pebble. See - Marumpa.
marumpa: A small stone (or) pebble. See - Marumpa.
marumpacuṇṇa: [Marumpa+cuṇṇa] (na) CL=7 Pebble (or) small stone powder. See - Marumpa.
marupapāta: [Maru+papāta]  CL=9 (1) falling down from the hilltop.
maruppapāta: [Maru+papāta] (pu) CL=7 (1) Falling down from the top of a hill. (2) Summit (or) the top of a hill. Cliff. See - Maruppapātapatana.
maruppapātapatana: [Maruppapāta+patana] (na) CL=7 Falling down from the top of a mountain.
maruppapātapatita: [Maruppapāta+patita] (ti) CL=7 One who is falling down from the cliff of a mountain.
maruppiya: [Maru+piya] (pu) CL=7 One who is loved by Deva.
marīca: [Mara+ca] (na) CL=7 Black pepper (or) Chilli. See - Marica.
marīci: [Mara+īca] (thī,pu) CL=7 [Dhāna,ṭī.64.] Color. Marīci(thī,pu) [marīci+i.dhāna,ṭī.65.] Rays of light (or) a mirrage.
marīcidhamma: [Marīci+dhamma]  CL=9 Having the nature of being like a mirage.
marīcikammaṭṭhānika: [Marīcikammaṭṭhāna+ika]  CL=9 One who meditates on mirage.
marīcikūpama: [Marīcikā+upamā]  CL=9 With a simile of mirage, like a mirage.
marīcisamaññā: [Marīci+samaññā]  CL=9 The name- designation that is mirage.
maraṇabhayasatajjita: [Maraṇabhaya+saṃtajjita]  CL=9 one who is fearful on the fear of death.
maraṇasavattanika: [Maraṇa+saṃvattanika]  CL=10 That which causes death. See maraṇasaṃvattanika-upakaraṇa.
maraṇasavattanikaupakaraṇa: [Maraṇasaṃvattanika+upakaraṇa]  CL=10 A structure that causes death, a weapon that kills.
maraṇasavattanikaupakkama: [Maraṇasaṃvattanika+upakkama]  CL=10 Effort or exertion that causes or leads to death.
maraṇasavattanikaupakkamakaraṇa: [Maraṇasaṃvattanikaupakkama+karaṇa]  CL=10 Engaging in effort or exertion that causes or leads to death.
maraṇasavattanikavisa: [Maraṇasaṃvattanika+visa]  CL=10 Poison that causes or leads to death.
maraṇavaṇṇasavaṇṇana: [Maraṇavaṇṇa+saṃvaṇṇana] (thī,na) CL=7 Praise for the advantages of death.
maraṇavaṇṇasavaṇṇanavatthu: [Maraṇavaṇṇasaṃvaṇṇana+vatthu] (na) CL=7 The story that praises the advantages of death.
maraṇavaṇṇasavaṇṇanādhippāya: [Maraṇavaṇṇasaṃvaṇṇana+adhippāya] (pu) CL=7 Desire to praise the advantage of death.
mareyyu: [Mara+eyyuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They would die. See - Marati.
mariyādapaṭisayutta: [Mariyādā+paṭisaṃyutta] (ti) CL=7 Related to the limit (or) boundary.
